items.name: Map of the World
items.where: Loot the Tortuga Warehouse; the key is in a banana crate just west of the plantation centre (first raid).

items.name: Vanitas Still-life
items.where: Loot the Kingston North Warehouse; an enemy patrolling the manor in the northeast of the warehouse area holds the key.

items.name: An English Ship in Action with Barbary Vessels
items.where: Loot the New Bone Warehouse; an enemy at the Mayan Stelae in the northwest corner holds the key.

items.name: Harbor Scene at Sunset
items.where: Loot the Nassau Warehouse; an enemy on the southwest beach holds the key, and nearby guards hint at it.

items.name: Merry Company
items.where: Loot the Matanzas Warehouse; the key is on a body behind the crocodile pond on a small corner island in the southwest.

items.name: Nymphs By A Fountain
items.where: Loot the Kingston South Warehouse; an enemy directly north of the big barn holds the key.

items.name: Saint Jerome as Cardinal
items.where: Loot the Havana Warehouse; an enemy in the northwest corner of the plantation holds the key.

items.name: The Burning of the Royal James
items.where: Given automatically; no warehouse looting needed.
items.gate: Granted in Sequence 03 Mission 05 (Sugarcane and Its Yields)

items.name: The Flight into Egypt
items.where: Loot the Black Island Warehouse; a soldier at a campfire on the path to the southwest beach holds the key. Can bug out; suggested fix is to finish Lucy's 2nd officer quest then wait 2 real hours for enemies to respawn.

items.name: Der Liederliche Student
items.where: Buy from the secret general store there.

items.name: Vanitas Still-life (Pieter Cleasz)
items.where: Buy from the secret general store there; counts as separate from the warehouse Vanitas painting.

items.name: Harbour Scene at Sunset (Claude Lorrin)
items.where: Buy from the secret general store there; counts as separate from the Nassau painting.

notes: Nine come from warehouses and three from a merchant; only 9 are needed for the Dilettante art collection. All can be hung in Great Inagua Manor. The three bought ones list under Strange Paintings in the Codex. A commenter says those three did not appear for them; no fix given. A reply says at least one more painting is needed to fully decorate the manor, but the platinum is still possible without it.
